name: Pipeliners - Title Meta Rewrites Tempe Buckeye Florence 2026-08-31
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-31

# Summary
Title, meta and og:title rewrites for /tempe/, /buckeye/ and /florence/, drafted Aug 31, 2026, revised after per-page keyword verification, and then deployed through OTTO the same day (Rank Math is deactivated; OTTO owns titles and metas).

# Key findings
- Tempe: page demand "sewer line repair" 641 impressions; "sewer line repair in tempe az" 556 at position 19 is the biggest keyword on the site. Old title omitted "Line". Title, meta and og:title changed.
- Buckeye: three near-equal clusters (water line 294, pipe repair 266, pipe break 263). The first draft would have dropped pipe break; revised title "Pipe Break & Water Line Repair in Buckeye, AZ | Pipeliners". 281 impressions of gas demand Pipeliners cannot serve.
- Florence: title kept ("florence pipe break repair" 162 at position 7 was already covered); meta and og:title changed and slab leak added. Florence ranks for many out-of-state and non-Florence towns, so weight it below Tempe and Buckeye.
- Phone: 480-535-6503 (the number the site renders everywhere and in schema). The /free-sewer-inspection/ meta showed 480-447-5345 (later confirmed as a GHL number, not a defect).
- Claims used were all verified (10 to 20 year warranty on /about-us/, free camera inspection, trenchless, pipe materials named in the page copy).

# Decisions and status
- Deployed Aug 31 via OTTO bulk edit: 9 fields (Tempe 3, Buckeye 3, Florence 2 plus og). Verified live 9 of 9.
- Purge gotcha: after a second edit round Tempe and Buckeye reverted on the front end while OTTO said deployed. Fix was a full WP cache flush plus per-URL and full LiteSpeed purges. Always re-verify live HTML after every purge round.
